situations.note: Return the camera to aperture priority or an appropriate automatic mode. Ask the participant to concentrate on viewpoint, timing, and composition. Understanding the visual effect matters more than operating everything manually.
Shorten partner sharing to two minutes, but preserve time for photography. If necessary, remove one mission rather than rushing every remaining activity.
